QuestInfo.name: Please Be My Friend
QuestInfo.1: The #bStreetsweeper#k is also definitely ignoring you. Time to find other citizens. How about that #bkindergarden teacher#k?
QuestInfo.2: You talked to the #bkindergarden teacher#k. He has a favor to ask.

Can proceed to Can We Be Friends?

0.0: Oh, no, no. Don't waste your time with me. I don't need the type of help you can offer. Go ask someone else, hm?

yes.0: That's right, just keep walking, walking, walking. Go on. Shoo! Shoo!\r\n#b(Maybe I should try that #ekindergarten teacher#n?)

no.0: Aw, did I hurt the piece of trash's feelings?

1.0: You want to know if I need help with anything? \r\nAre you kidding me? Absolutely I need help.

yes.0: What wonderful timing! I was just looking around wondering if I could find someone to help me.\r\n#b(Continue listening.)

npc.0: Out of the way... I need to sweep! \r\n#b(Talk to the #ekindergarten teacher#n.)
